reviews.title: Fast, efficient, pretty rich solution that brings extra site performance
reviews.comment:
I was pleasantly surprised with this solution, in the case of multilingual Wordpress sites.

I use both SearchWP and Relevannsi on my sites and this is hands down way better in my case where I use long form content and complex faceted taxonomy criteria. The reason, most perfomance freaks will confirm, is that both plugins above create massive DB entries that in turn impact the site's ability to swiflty perform quite a lot of the basic tasks required to run a WP site. Being able to resolve this issue will extend to a lot of other systems that don't use an external search system. 
And that is what Search IQ brings you, a very fast external search system.

What is pretty amazing though, is that, in the case of WP sites specifically, and probably well structured sites using other CMS, it pulls all the relevant data through their WP plugin with options to decide whether or not to include ACF type fieds. There are lots of options to define the visual aspect of the results and you have both an Autocomplete function and full page results (using an iframe).

It is all geared towards a (so far) stellar solution, far faster than WP with Memcached an even Redis when using SearchWP or Relevannsi. OK if you have a Redis stored query that a person hits (a second time) they may be on par, to be fair, but that is not going to cover all the random searches on a site and teh first time people search for something.

Issues I found, are the ability to change the 'fixed' text components for both search boxes, autocomplete and results that are not in English. There are tricks and workarounds but for SEO purposes there needs to be more thought given for a long term.

Finally, why oh why are you not allowing people to stack this. 
You want as many as people as possible using and getting to know about this, not this half baked offer. Your solution is pretty amazing. But the (restrictions) terms of your offer are good (acceptable) for only a few people here on Appsumo and not the ones who will make the most noise and spread the word about it. Check out what WebFactory do and have done, some pretty clever strategies with their Appsumo offers...

Well worth the money and I would invest far more to get to the next level, for more docs, more options and more control over the layout of the results (which is already very good). Personally not bothered about PDF support for example but wouldn't say no to it.

questions.title: Google’s current spam policies let me questioning regarding the use of large-scale location page generation
questions.comment:
Google rolled out the August 2026 Spam Update (18–21 August 2026). Google's spam policies also cover Scaled Content Abuse and Doorway Abuse – especially when many pages are generated with nearly identical content and only the location or keyword is changed.

Could you please let us know:

Are you monitoring the update's impact on pages created with your platform?
Are you planning updates or features to make mass-generated location pages more compliant?
Specifically: meaningful content variation per page, automatic quality checks, duplicate-content detection, noindex/sitemap controls, unique local content per location, or guidance on which pages should be indexed?
What do you recommend for users who have already generated hundreds or thousands of similar location pages?

children.comment:
Hi. Thank you for reaching out.

Of course, we're always keeping an eye for Google's updates, including the August 2026 Spam Update.

It is important to note that Google's policies around scaled content and doorway pages are not new. Google regularly updates its spam-detection systems, but the underlying principle remains largely the same: generating pages at scale is not automatically considered spam. The problem is when pages are created primarily to manipulate search rankings and provide little or no additional value to visitors.

That is why our recommendation remains to focus on relevant, well-written, SEO-proof content that is genuinely useful to the visitor.

With SEO Generator, we strongly recommend using Spintax to introduce meaningful variation throughout your content instead of simply publishing hundreds or thousands of pages where only a city or keyword changes. Where possible, you can also add information that is specifically relevant to the location, service, audience, or search intent of that page.

For existing websites with hundreds or thousands of generated pages, we would not recommend removing or noindexing everything simply because the pages were generated at scale. Instead, review whether the pages offer useful content and whether they make sense as individual landing pages. Pages that are extremely thin, irrelevant, or provide virtually no additional value are the ones we would reconsider or improve.

At this point, we don't see the August update as requiring a fundamental change to how SEO Generator works. The important distinction is not manually created versus automatically generated content, but useful content versus content created primarily to manipulate rankings.

As always, SEO Generator is a tool: the quality and usefulness of the content you create with it remain important.

Kind regards,
Tim & Jeroen
SEO Generator

reviews.title: The one of a kind tool which is pure Gold.
reviews.comment:
Frankly, speaking, this tool is not for everyone. It has a special target audience for whom it is pure Gold. 

If you are into SEO industry, you must be well aware of the power of quality backlinks and the role it plays in ranking a site to the top of search engine. Getting quality backlinks is hard, and it takes a lengthy procedure researching the websites, evaluating  their metrics and doing outreach with the owner to come up with a deal for a Guest post and link insert. Often, the deal also requires paying a publishing fee or giving a link in exchange. No doubt, gaining backlinks is a tough process. 

But backlinks keep getting lost regularly for various reasons. Sometimes, the reason is technical, and sometimes it is a human error (done willingly or by mistake).  

 99% of the backlinks monitor tools in the market come in the following category:-
 
1)	They are either domain oriented - meaning depending upon their pricing plans, we can monitor backlinks of a limited set of domains only. As such, they are totally useless for a professional SEO agency doing backlinks for multiple domains without beating astronomical costs.

2)	They monitor only those backlinks of a website  which their own crawler is able to detect while crawling the web (like Ahrefs). It was also a useless feature for us because we were looking specifically for monitoring our own  created backlinks. 

In my search for reliable backlinks monitor tool, I finally shortlisted two tools: Hexowatch and Backlink Monitor. While Hexowatch has become a big name in monitoring various assets, its backlink monitoring tool is very, very basic. It does not allow bulk upload and one has to manually enter the backlinks one by one to enter the same into the system.  

Backlink Checker has come as a breath of fresh air as it fulfills all the requirements of a link monitoring campaign. You are allowed to monitor backlinks of any domain you want with no restriction  and you can monitor all the past created backlinks of your client. Then they have a robust CSV upload feature that allows you to bulk upload all the backlinks for a project in one go. 

Once we upload the backlinks and set the system, it is all automatic. Based on the frequency of monitoring set by us, we can get regular emails on weekly / monthly basis about the status of the backlinks. 

The founder Yogi is super responsive. I had certain issues regarding the overall interface, and she immediately took action and resolved all the issues. 

In my opinion, it is a must-have tool for any serious backlink professional.  It is pure gold if the use case matches your requirement. Grab the tool as a Lifetime deal as long as it is available here.

The best part? Zero technical "headaches."

Most tools in this space still require you to understand data layers or complex triggers. With Measuremate, it feels like they’ve thought of everything for you. Every parameter you could possibly need for a professional setup is already preset. You don’t have to be a developer to use it- you literally just click "Push to GTM,"  and it’s done.

The Measurement Plan Builder: Instead of a messy spreadsheet, I built a structured tracking plan right in the app. It makes sure every tag actually has a business purpose.
Audit Checks: It automatically audits your setup to make sure your tracking is actually firing correctly. No more "guessing" if your data is accurate.
The GA4 Co-pilot: This is top-notch. It acts like a second set of eyes on your data, helping you navigate the complexities of GA4 without feeling lost.
Automated Report Delivery: The way it handles scheduled reports is incredibly smooth. I’m already getting the data I need delivered exactly when I want it, without manual exports.
AI Alerts & Insights: It actually alerts you if something looks off (like a spike in 404s or a drop in conversion), so you can fix issues before they ruin your data.
Whether you’re using their Figma plugin to plan tracking during design or their Chrome extension for debugging, the ecosystem is just seamless.

The Support: Huge shoutout to their support team—they are awesome. They are super responsive and actually help you understand the "why" behind the tracking, not just the "how."

questions.title: WordPress MetaData & WP to Telegram Compatibility
questions.comment:
Hi! I’m interested in your Lifetime Deal for my music news portal (WordPress). I have a very specific workflow: I use a plugin called 'WP to Telegram' that automatically grabs the short URL of a post the moment it's published to send it to a Telegram Channel.

My questions are:

Does your WordPress plugin automatically generate the short link and save it as a 'Post Meta' (metadata) in the WP database?

Is it compatible with 3rd party plugins like 'WP to Telegram' to ensure the short URL is detected instead of the default long permalink?

Can I use my branded domain (e.g., ver.mydomain.rocks) for these automated links with no total limit on the number of links created?

Thanks!

children.comment:
Hi, thanks for your detailed questions!

-> Regarding automatic generation:
LinkCentral does not automatically create a short link when a post is published. Short links have to be created manually. This gives you full control over the slug, redirect settings, tracking options, and conditions before the link goes live.

-> About metadata and compatibility:
LinkCentral is registered as a Custom Post Type inside WordPress. All link data is saved in the WordPress database using standard post meta. Because it uses native WordPress CPT, it is generally compatible with third party plugins.

However, LinkCentral does not automatically replace the default post permalink or inject its short URL into a blog post's meta fields created by other plugins. If your WP to Telegram plugin reads a specific meta key from a blog post itself, you would need either:
- a small custom hook to assign the LinkCentral URL to that post’s meta field, or
- a workflow where the Telegram plugin pulls the LinkCentral URL directly.

-> Regarding branded domains:
There is no limit on the number of links you can create. The short links use the domain where WordPress and LinkCentral are installed. So if WordPress+LinkCentral is installed on ver.mydomain.rocks, your links will use that domain.

Hope that helps!
- Jordy

questions.title: Awin & Breakdance wordpress
questions.comment: Hello, can the app be used for Awin? It works well with Breakdance WordPress?

children.comment:
Thanks for your question! Yes, you can use LinkCentral with any kind of internal or external link, including Awin. There is no automated Awin integration, but you can add any Awin affiliate link to LinkCentral and take advantage of the dynamic redirects and analytics.

At the moment, there is no built-in integration with Breakdance, though it’s on the roadmap. Without an integration, you won’t have a shortcut button to quickly add links inside the editor. All redirects and analytics will still work, because they are completely independent of the page builder you use.

Hope that helps! Feel free to try LinkCentral to see if it fits your setup, and let me know if you have any questions.
Thanks I know this will be a difficult question, but do you have any idea when integrationists will arrive at Breakdance? Is it at the top of the list?

At the moment, Breakdance is unfortunately not at the top of the roadmap. Realistically, it would be late 2026 at the earliest. The near-term focus for LinkCentral is on codebase optimizations and improvements to Analytics. Once that is complete, we'll shift attention to page builder integrations, starting with Bricks. Breakdance would most likely follow, though I can’t make any promises yet.

children.comment:
Hi, thanks for your question!

At the moment, LinkCentral does not automatically create short links or QR codes when a page or post is created, nor does it automatically display them via a shortcode.

LinkCentral is primarily designed for manually creating and managing links to external destinations. Internal links are fully supported as well, but they need to be created manually.

Let me know if you’d like to know more!

– Jordy

At the moment, uncloaking is not supported. Because LinkCentral uses dynamic redirects, the final URL is resolved at runtime, which makes uncloaked links hard to realize.

There is an option to automatically include the category name in the slug, which several users have said complies with Amazon’s policies.

Any questions or to discuss options, feel free to reach out at jordy [at] designforwp.com

reviews.title: Simple, useful, and actually gets used
reviews.comment:
Seline is one of those tools that looks simple at first, but becomes more valuable once real data starts coming in.
Setup was quick, the interface is clean, and it makes it very easy to understand where visitors come from, which pages they view, and whether they actually reach the goals I care about.
The funnel feature is especially useful. I can define a conversion path in minutes and immediately start seeing what percentage of visitors complete it. Traffic sources, visitor journeys, page performance, and conversions are presented without the complexity of heavier analytics platforms.
I also like that the product stays focused. It gives me the information I need without turning analytics into another full-time job.
Two things I would love to see improved:
1. Deeper AI/referrer attribution, especially for traffic coming from ChatGPT and other AI assistants, so AI traffic can be separated and analyzed more precisely.
2. More automated insights and anomaly detection, for example notifying me when a page suddenly converts better/worse or when a new traffic source starts producing meaningful conversions.
Overall, Seline has earned a permanent place in my workflow because it is fast, understandable, and genuinely useful rather than simply having a long feature list.

questions.title: Few questions Below:
questions.comment:
Do Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and X connect through each platform’s official API? Has any customer lost an account?
What are the API rate limits? Does the create post endpoint support an Idempotency-Key, so retries can’t double post?
Do API keys expire, and can I set an expiry?
Which lifetime terms could change later, and what happens to lifetime accounts if the company closes or is sold?
Can I export my posts and analytics if I leave?

children.comment:
Hi!

1. Yes. Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and X all connect through each platform's official API.

2. No customer has lost an account. We never ask for your password. You grant us permission through the platform's own login screen, and that permission only covers posting and analytics.

3. The API allows 600 requests per minute per API key. Every response includes RateLimit headers, so you can see how many requests you have left. Normal use won't come close.

4. No Idempotency-Key. Creating a post returns a unique post ID, and retries happen on that post, not by creating a new one. If you're unsure whether a post went through, look it up by its ID.

5. Yes. You can set a custom expiry date when you create an API key.

6. The deal follows the AppSumo listing, and those terms won't change. Lifetime means for the life of the product.

7. Yes. You can export your analytics, and the export includes your post details.

Taras

Yes, AdaptlyPost can turn any RSS or Atom feed into drafts, scheduled posts or published posts. We added it recently.

We don't pull content from Reddit directly. A Reddit feed might work, or it might be blocked by Reddit's anti-spam system.

RSS would work the best for the feed that you have full control over.

Taras

We support text posts as well

reviews.title: Useful Tool, but Needs Better Sensitivity for Transgender Content
reviews.comment:
BizReply is a handy tool, and the core functionality is definitely there. It makes responding to social media posts faster and easier, and I’ve found it particularly useful when managing engagement for my retail company. In that context, it does what I need it to do quite well.

Where I’ve struggled is using it for my transgender support and education platform. As the founder of that platform, I frequently engage with content involving transgender people, LGBTQ+ issues, healthcare, legislation, and current events. BizReply doesn’t always seem sensitive enough to the nuances of transgender topics, which can result in responses that feel inappropriate, overly generic, or simply miss the context of the conversation.

That makes it difficult to rely on for one of the areas where I could actually use automation the most. Better contextual understanding of LGBTQ+ topics (particularly transgender issues) would make a substantial difference.

I can honestly say that Lorenzo is the main reason I’m sticking with and actively using HoneyLogs now. He guided me through the entire setup process, even taking the time to help during the weekend.  

But there’s more to it than that. When I set it up, it was like a wake-up call—it made me realize my website really needed some changes. It felt like I’d been sleeping in a bed of snakes: warm, gross, and honestly terrifying once you see who’s actually visiting your site. Bots, fake users, and spammy IPs were all there!

By the way, the setup was easier than I expected (still took a lot to wrap the concept around the head and then implement it at first but now I know what to expect going forward), and this was the first time I moved my namserver to Cloudflare.

To sum it up, HoneyLogs not only shows me which bots are visiting but also gives me a way to tackle that big question every SEO and GEO expert wonders about: how can I optimize my site’s visibility? Highly recommended, and thank you Lorenzo for all you help!

reviews.title: Much More Than an AI Bot Tracker
reviews.comment:
I originally bought Honeylog to see AI crawlers and bots that normal analytics and WordPress can miss. After using it on real traffic, I realized it is much more useful than that.
The strongest part for me is the evidence. I can see verified crawlers, fake bots, suspicious “human” traffic, the exact URLs being crawled, sitemap coverage, status codes and bot behavior without relying on JavaScript analytics.
The report and raw-log tools are especially useful because they help separate real crawler activity from misleading traffic. Bot Conversions is also a very interesting direction because it starts connecting crawling activity with actual human visits.
Honeylog has become one of the tools I trust when I need to understand what is really happening on a website rather than what a normal analytics dashboard assumes is happening.
Two things I would love to see next:
1. More actionable insights — not only showing what happened, but suggesting the likely cause and the next thing to check.
2. Stronger custom views / actor classification so monitoring services, owned bots, SEO crawlers and suspicious traffic can be separated very easily.
The product has real depth and the support has been responsive. I’m very happy I kept it.

children.comment:
Hi safex147,

Thanks for your review! We are glad you’re enjoying the product. Regarding the two suggested improvements, both are in our roadmap: we are in the process of adding new actionable insights and custom views will be soon released to let you segment the traffic as you wish!

reviews.title: Much more useful than I expected, but there’s a learning curve
reviews.comment:
I bought Tier 1 expecting a dashboard of which AI bots were hitting my site. What I actually got was visibility into things I'd never seen before: whether Googlebot has found an article I just published, traffic HoneyLog identifies as Fake Human despite normal-looking browser user agents, and a world of 404s I rarely see in GA4.

The report builder is the standout feature. Instead of "Googlebot visited 9 times," I can ask which URLs, which status codes, and how long each request took. That's saved me from a couple of wrong conclusions already, including one case where 12 requests to an article turned out to all be Fake Human once I filtered by bot.

Two honest gripes. Onboarding is rough: I hit an unclear "waiting for aggregation" message with no sense of how long to expect, and ended up contacting support. HoneyLog is also much better at showing you what happened than telling you what to do about it. If you're comfortable digging into the data, that's fine. If you want a tool that hands you the next steps, it's not there yet.

I'm keeping Tier 1. It's already surfacing insights I'm not getting anywhere else in my stack, and the 60-day return window gives you time to let HoneyLog prove its value on your own site before deciding.

Full hands-on review with screenshots and examples:
MarketingWithDave.com HoneyLog Review

reviews.title: Makes Pinterest Faster, Not Hands-Off
reviews.comment:
Pin Generator does not fully automate Pinterest, but it does make you a lot faster.

I was hesitant to buy for the longest time. I knew it wouldn’t be set it and forget it, but I wasn’t sure it would provide enough value. I was wrong.

You can generate batches of pins quickly, review what works, refine them, and publish more consistently. I am creating more pins now because of it.

It is not hands-off. You will still review and tweak outputs, but that is also what keeps quality up.

Top 3 Pros:
1. Fast pin creation at scale. Generate batches and move much quicker than doing everything manually.
2. Template flexibility. Once you find a design that works, it is easy to duplicate and iterate.
3. Useful insights. Keyword research, trends, and the profile audit help guide what to create and improve.

Watch Outs:
1. Set realistic expectations on automation. You still need to review and select what to publish.
2. Some workflow friction. A few settings and steps could be smoother.
3. Pinterest limitations. API restrictions impact things like categories and posting control.

If Pinterest is part of your strategy, this is at least worth giving it a test drive. Just go in with the right expectations.

I provided a more detailed review here:
https://marketingwithdave.com/pin-generator-review/

Ollie, I couldn't find a way to reply to your comment so I am adding my response here.
Thank you for the reply. I really like the product and would love to keep providing feedback. Here are a few areas that I think would have the biggest impact:

1. Automation improvements
I mentioned to Candice the idea of automatically adding alt text to pins that are missing it. That feels like low-hanging fruit most users would enable without needing review.
More broadly, it would be great if automations had controls at the board or section level, with the ability to run batch updates (alt text, titles, links, etc.). A wizard-style flow with an “apply to all” option would make this very efficient.

2. URL management and reuse
During setup, selecting URLs works fine at first, but it quickly becomes difficult to track what’s already been used across a larger website.
It would help to have a persistent URL library that shows:
Which URLs have pins created
Ability to search and filter
Ability to select the next batch
Optional notes or status
This could become more of a control center for ongoing use.

3. Queue visibility
I created ~20 pins and selected about five to refine and publish. I used “add to queue,” but I haven’t been able to find this queue.
If there is a queue, it’s not obvious. If not, having a clearly visible saved/queued area would help a lot.

4. Access to previous batches
The only way I’ve found to revisit past images is through “view recent batches” in Automation, which is easy to miss.
A more visible library view of all generated or imported images, with the ability to organize (keep, delete, group), would improve the workflow. Folders or tagging could help here.

5. Image sourcing workflow
Providing a URL to pull images from can feel slow and inconsistent, especially with sources like Amazon.
It would be helpful to have a more direct way to select images, possibly via a browser extension, that could also pull in title, description, alt text, and my affiliate link in one step.

children.comment:

questions.title: some clarifications about Content Curation and other
questions.comment:
Hi SocialBu team! A few final clarifications before purchasing:

1. Your Sept 18 reply says Content Curation is included (3 feeds in Tier 2, 10 in Tier 3), but the AppSumo FAQ says it's excluded from all tiers. Which is contractually correct?
2. Can an AI user with restricted team permissions create or edit automation workflows via MCP, or can those actions be blocked independently from creating drafts?
3. Can one uploaded MP4 be reused for scheduled posts across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, each with separate captions and dates, without re-uploading?
4. Are approval workflows and automation settings isolated per Team, including when managed through MCP?
5. Are all existing and future MCP tools included in Tier 2 lifetime, subject only to plan limits?

Thanks!

children.comment:
Content Curation is included in the current AppSumo Tier 2, Tier 3 and Tier 4.

The AppSumo FAQ statement saying Curate is excluded is outdated and should be corrected. 

Automation permissions can be controlled independently from post creation. Team permissions separately cover creating posts, creating automations, managing automations, and approving posts. You can therefore allow an AI-connected user to create drafts while withholding the automation permissions.

The current MCP automation tools can list and inspect automations, view logs, and enable or disable accessible automations. MCP does not currently provide tools for creating or editing an automation’s trigger, conditions, or actions. Access to Team automations requires the Team’s Manage Automations permission.

An uploaded MP4 can be reused across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube without selecting and uploading the file from the device again. In the composer, you can publish the shared media to several accounts and customize captions per account. When the dates differ, create the first scheduled post and use Duplicate for the others; the media is carried into the duplicated post. Each destination still applies its own video format, duration, size, account-type, and publishing-option requirements.

Approval requirements and automation definitions are scoped to the selected Team. MCP follows the same Team and account permissions as the signed-in SocialBu user. Plan quotas remain pooled under the Team owner even though the workflows and settings are Team-specific.

questions.title: Limit of monthly automation executions
questions.comment:
Hi SocialBu team! Before buying Tier 2/3, please clarify:

Your Sept 2026 AppSumo guide says monthly automation executions are unlimited, but the AppSumo FAQ states 5,000 for Tier 2 and 20,000 for Tier 3. Which limits are contractually guaranteed for lifetime buyers?

Are limits (AI credits, posts, executions, Listen items) shared across all Teams or allocated per Team?

Does Tier 2's 1 Listen stream monitor only one brand, or can it cover multiple Teams/brands?

Can MCP submit scheduled video posts directly to Awaiting Approval, with automatic publishing after human approval and no manual rescheduling?

Are RSS-triggered workflows included in Tier 2, given your guide says legacy RSS allowance is zero?

Does the owner’s personal workspace count toward the 3-Team limit?

Thanks!

children.comment:
Thanks for checking these details. The correct monthly automation execution allowances for the AppSumo lifetime plans are:
- Tier 2: 5,000 executions per month
- Tier 3: 20,000 executions per month
The September guide’s “unlimited” statement is incorrect and should be corrected. The AppSumo FAQ limits match the entitlements currently configured and enforced by SocialBu.

Plan usage is generally pooled under the billing owner. It is not a fresh allowance for every Team:
- AI credits are shared by the owner’s personal workspace and Teams they own.
- Monthly posts are shared across the connected accounts billed to that owner.
- Automation executions are shared across personal and Team automations billed to that owner.
- Listen streams and monthly matched items are shared across the owner’s personal workspace and owned Teams.
- Work performed in a Team owned by someone else uses that Team owner’s applicable plan and quota.

Tier 2 includes one Listen stream in total. A stream can contain up to ten search expressions and monitor multiple supported sources, so it can include terms for more than one brand. However, the stream belongs to one personal or Team workspace; it cannot be assigned to several Teams at the same time, and results for multiple brands will be combined in that stream.

MCP can create a scheduled video post directly in Awaiting Approval by supplying the video, scheduled time etc.. Once an authorized reviewer approves it, it becomes eligible for automatic publishing. If approval happens before its scheduled time, it publishes at that time. If approval happens after the scheduled time, it will get published right away at approval.

RSS-triggered automation workflows are included in Tier 2, subject to Tier 2’s limit of 30 automation rules and 5,000 monthly executions. The separate feeds: 0 allowance refers to the legacy Feed feature; it does not disable the RSS trigger inside Automations.

The owner’s personal workspace does not count toward the Team limit. Tier 2 permits three created Teams in addition to the personal workspace.

reviews.title: One Year Review
reviews.comment:
After testing this software over a period of time (purchased April 2022), I am finally leaving a review. 

Here are my observations in chronological order: 

1. At first, I was very excited about the UI.  It seemed to work as advertised and continues to do so far.  

2. The download to my Windows OS was not preferable, as I change devices based on my portable needs.  However, it was a great alternative to monthly subscriptions, so it was a concession I was willing to make. 

3. The time to full implementation took me about 10 days (30-45 minute sessions).  I am not a developer, so I tend to read all the details before engaging if I am taking on new software ventures myself.  

4. My audience has sensitive needs, and I wanted to ensure my site would not be penalized.  It has not been so far. 

5. The repin and scheduling features were my main needs.  I don't mind spending a few hours/days setting it up if automation needed only minor tweaking (less than 1 hour per week) was needed to keep it going. 

6.  The unadvertised and unexpected bonus is that I was able to conduct some research to target posts.  I launched another initiative that gained immediate traction based on my findings (targeting, key phrases, etc); so for that alone, it was worth the investment. I like data science for my breakfast cereal, so this was very good for such a product. 

Overall, I wish it was available without putting my computer and social account at risk, but it is only for one brand account. I don't use it much as I could, simply because I manage most of my social accounts on the go by a portable device not suited for this download. 

If I were managing more than one brand using this software, I would look at different alternatives.  

5 tacos because it works as advertised and the developers continue to improve.

reviews.title: Social Proof Without Friction
reviews.comment:
Acknowledging the importance of testimonials and social proof in business, LoveBoard arrived at a perfect time. Our current solution frequently disconnects from Meta due to token expiration, and limits captured reviews up to 100 only. Additionally, Google no longer supports review schema markup on SERPs for local businesses. 

This is why we decided to also collect reviews directly from clients instead of relying on social platforms, which can create friction and potentially hold our hard-earned reviews hostage.

While most platforms require signing in or creating an account, LoveBoard makes it easy and seamless to give a testimonial for your brand. No complexities and zero friction!

Video reviews is where LoveBoard takes the crown. The in-browser collection makes it easy for clients. No app or sign-in needed. Why does this matter? Studies show that video reviews are up to 27 times more engaging than text testimonials, 9.5 times better for information retention, and 1.9 times more effective at driving sales conversion!

On the platform, I love that LoveBoard is easy to learn and use with no learning curve. The UI/UX is neat and organized, including the analytics. I embedded it on two of our websites via iFrame. I tested the mason, grid, carousel, and badge embeds, and we had no issues at all.

What I love to see:

- Smoother carousel animation
- Auto-approve reviews on/off toggle
- CNAME (sumoling favorite)
- Color options to match our website
- Pop-up widget embed type
- Import reviews from sources (CSV or URL)

The limits on this LTD are very generous, even on the lower tiers. Given its value, potential, and responsive support, I plan to upgrade to a higher tier soon!

Grab this now while you can! :)

questions.title: Image limits and automatic WordPress storage
questions.comment:
Hi! Before buying, please clarify:

1) The tiers include 500, 5,000, and 25,000 OG images respectively. Are these limits on images stored on your servers across all connected sites, with no monthly reset? What happens when full? Would deleting images break older social previews?

2) Can the WordPress plugin automatically save generated images to my Media Library and use local URLs, without manual downloads? Would this avoid the hosted-image limit?

3) How many WordPress sites can one license connect?

4) Does the two-template limit also include premade gallery templates?

Thank you in advance for your clarification!

children.comment:
Hi! Thanks for your questions. Here’s how it works:

1. Yes, the 500, 5,000, and 25,000 limits apply to images currently hosted across all sites using your workspace, with no monthly reset. Once full, new images cannot be generated until you delete older renders or upgrade. With the WordPress plugin’s dynamic URLs, deleted images can regenerate when requested again, provided the template/version remains available and there’s room in your allowance. Regenerated images count toward the limit again. 
Deleting images can eventually break older social previews that use them. Social platforms may retain cached copies for some time, so the effect might not be immediate.

2. The plugin currently uses our hosted image URLs. It doesn’t automatically save generated images to your Media Library or switch to local URLs. You can download images separately and upload them to WordPress. Using the download workflow without hosting the images with us avoids the hosted-image allowance, but this isn’t currently automated by the plugin.

3. You can connect unlimited WordPress sites to one licensed workspace. They share that workspace’s image and template allowances.

4. Yes, a premade gallery design counts toward your template allowance once you copy it into your workspace for editing or automation. Browsing the gallery doesn’t use a slot, and you can choose from the available designs.

Hope that helps clarify before you buy.

Value of credits
questions.comment: Maybe I'm stupid, or maybe I overlooked the answer to my question. But I don't see any explanation as to what exactly we get for a certain amount of credits. In other words, how do credits translate to what we get out of the product? Likewise, I see you've referred to there being a difference between credits that renew, and credits that never expire. But what is that difference? What does it mean to users that some credits renew, and some never expire? Please clarify the whole credits situation so I know what I need to buy. Thanks.

children.comment:
Hi there, not a silly question at all. Here’s the whole picture.

What a credit gets you: 1 credit = 1 creator exported, with their profile, stats and email, ready for outreach. Searching is free, and every search shows your top 10 matching creators free so you can check they’re a good fit before spending anything. Credits are only used for a few things: exporting creators (1 credit each), loading an extra page of 10 previews (1 credit), and tracking a creator’s post performance (2 credits per post per month).

Renewing vs. never-expiring credits: monthly credits come with your plan (100, 300 or 800 a month, depending on your tier). They refresh every month for life, but unused ones don’t carry over, so it’s “use them or lose them” each month. Add-on credits are ones you buy separately at $49 per 1,000. They’re a one-time top-up, and they never expire, so they sit in your account until you use them.

What to buy: think about how many creators you’ll reach out to each month. If it’s around 100, Tier 1 works. Around 300, Tier 2. Around 800, Tier 3. Tiers 2 and 3 also come with launch bonus credits (1,500 and 3,500) to get you started, plus MCP access. If you occasionally need more for a big campaign, top up with add-on credits instead of buying a bigger tier.

reviews.title: Promising, but held back by registration limitation and poor localisation
reviews.comment:
I had high hopes for BeHuman.Online (BHO) as a viable alternative to Zoom Webinar. The platform generally looks great, but unfortunately, I came across a few limitations that means I will be requesting a refund after writing this review.

The key limitations for me are around the following areas:
1. Registration:
I need a system where attendees can simply register with an email address, double opt-in to confirm a valid emai address, and they receive their unique join link (for future attendance reporting) - that's it, as simple as this!

However, BHO currently mandates that Google Login, Email, and SMS options are ALL visible options. The biggest concern I have is that all of these methods requires the guest to create a dedicated BHO account. I do not want to force my webinar guests to sign up for a third-party platform just to attend my webinar. Additionally,
(a) My attendees are generally business that use O365. I don't want someone see the Google option and to feel using their personal GMail account is an option for them and something we'd request.
(b) I don't want SMS even listed as an option as collecting phone numbers feels unnecessarily invasive (for my needs at least) - it's either none ('anonymous') or all three options visible.

Our Website Privacy Statement likely doesn't allow for capturing (a) and/or (b) above.

When I reached out to support about the registration issue, they initially suggested using their "anonymous" and "form" features. I don't feel this option capturing registrations, but instead designed to allow guests to click the link on the day. This does not work for my webinars where I need to track attendee numbers before the event - potentially cancelling the event if numbers aren't there. When I clarified and pointed this out, support referred me back to using their standard registration feature. When I replied again, advising their standard registration doesn't work for me per the reasons stated in my original support request, asked how I can simply do email address/double opt-in/unique link - it's now over one week and I haven't heard back.

2. Localisation: I don't believe BHO currently caters well to a global audience. The registration page locks you into a US date format (as far as I could tell). Additionally, the SMS field always defaults to a US country code rather than auto-detecting the guest's location via IP address. I know of many online apps seamlessly default to a user's local country code, so I believe BHO creates a clunky experience for international guests.

It is a shame, as the interface looks promising, but these basic functional gaps and the lack of final support resolution has stopped me from fully evaluating or adopting BeHuman.Online.

EDIT (after reply from founder): 
Fantastic news! It is a real testament to the hard work you put into your business. Not only taking feedback seriously but prompt development for a resolution (I hope double opt-in option is there too to help reduce any potential spam entries). 

The last feedback, if I may, is I wish someone had just provided me a status update. I (now) completely understand the priority was fix and make a customer happy, but after a week of silence, as far I was concerned, my request was too difficult so I took the path of least resistance. Kudos to you and your team for the outcome - upping from 3 to 4 tacos. I will consider re-purchasing.

We genuinely appreciate thoughtful feedback like this, and I wanted to share that two of your suggestions have already been built into the platform and are live now.

You can now individually control which registration methods are available to attendees, including Google, SMS, and Email. This means hosts can choose the registration flow that best fits their audience and event format.

We have also added automatic country detection for the SMS registration option, so the attendee’s country is pre-selected based on their location, creating a smoother experience for international guests.

Feedback like yours is genuinely helpful to us. We regularly use customer suggestions to improve BeHuman.Online, and these were excellent examples of practical improvements that made the platform better.

reviews.title: I canceled my Tier 4 order faster than I ordered it
reviews.comment:
I canceled my Tier 4 order faster than I ordered it.

Why?

It says 2,000,000 credits included – in reality, it's only 1,950,000. That's a huge difference, especially since each transaction consumes a significant number of credits. My support ticket hasn't been processed to this day, confirming other users' experiences that support is sorely lacking. This doesn't bode well for the future viability of a young company.

Then it says voice clones are included. They are. Four of them. In a test account, I could select the option to clone my existing voice for dubbing. Here, I can't do that and have to make do with one of the available voices, and I can't use my own custom voice clones – even though the dubbing is supposed to be for the same speaker. The quality of the default voices is terrible, nowhere near as good as Elevenlabs and similar services. More like Revoicer. The voice clones themselves aren't outstanding yet, but they're perfectly usable; I expect further development will bring out the best in them.

If the voice clones were unlimited and usable for dubbing, I'd sign up again in a heartbeat. As it is, definitely not.

And of course, you need an additional subscription if you want to use all the gallery characters and voices. I knew there was a catch. I could live with that, though. But exporting MP3, video, SRT subtitles, and so on also costs extra. What's the point of an account that can't export anything except formats no one uses? Especially when I'm already buying the highest available plan?

The number of custom characters is also limited to a ridiculous four. The problem is, you can't delete them. I randomly selected four standard characters for testing purposes, and now I can't free up those slots. I assume these are a fixed four slots, not a monthly limit.







... With a lifetime deal, it's generally expected that you might want to work with a product long-term. Four voice clones and four default characters that can't be deleted seem very limiting to me. Saving and re-uploading later isn't possible either, so long-term planning isn't feasible.

What bothers me in general, though, is the credit system. You never really know what you're buying. 2,000,000 credits sounds like a lot at first; currently, they're enough for 16 hours of audio dubbing.

But HeyGen has consistently demonstrated how little credits are worth: a tripling of usage in May, an increase of almost 1.5 times in July – even with existing subscriptions. With Unmix, this would mean that, following HeyGen's inflationary approach, the 16 hours of dubbing would only last for 3.5 hours, whereas buying 16 hours of dubbing would still be worth 16 hours in 5 years. This is something you should always be aware of.

Therefore, my personal conclusion: stay away. If you encounter so many problems right from the start of a business, you can't expect things to improve.

reviews.title: Great library of sound FX, but I'm conflicted
reviews.comment:
I have to say the sound FX library is impressive, but Audiohero unfortunately succumbs to overpromising and underdelivering. 
The good: 
-the sound FX are very high quality, much better than what's offered IMO at, say, Audiio
-the library is broad

The not-so-good:
-the AI sound fx generator is bad. To be fair, even the premiere AI sound FX generator (ElevenLabs) is bad. But this is bad enough to be gimmicky if not entirely impractical
-the music is okay, no vocals from what I can tell. Audiio is in a whole other league in quality for music
-the promise of new sound FX added every week is not supported by the facts that I can tell. TBF, I only audited this for a week (7 days apart). And the total number of visible SFX actually went down to ~304k from ~306k. And the top 30 items in Week 2 consist entirely of horse locomotion and dirt footstep variations (Animals, Horses: Hard Pack Dirt). These naming conventions and audio files originate from the legacy Sound Ideas foley archive (AudioHero’s licensor and parent library), rather than newly commissioned recordings.

If my data is right, then that's misrepresentation of their promises. I may keep this for the existing library alone, but the real reason I bought this was for the promise of the library actually expanding weekly (I know, this isn't realistic on a LTD model ALONE, but that's not the pricing AudioHero does ALONE). Another big reason was the ability to generate my own SFX via their AI generator, but that's useless to me right now. And thirdly, for the music, but I'll be using Audiio. 

So, unless I can find another LTD for a comparable high quality library like this one, I'll keep it.

questions.comment:
Hi AudioHero Team,

I'm considering AudioHero for commercial podcast and video production and would appreciate clarification on four questions:

1. Music Ownership: Does AudioHero fully own its music? Can producers later redistribute tracks or register them with Content ID, causing future copyright claims on client projects?

2. Licensing: Does each track include a downloadable license certificate for resolving copyright disputes? Are licenses valid after cancellation?

3. YouTube Whitelisting: Can I whitelist client channels or videos before publishing to prevent copyright claims?

4. Rights and Royalties: What do "Ownership Share" and "Collection Share" mean, and do they affect commercial usage rights?

children.comment:

1. Music Ownership: AudioHero and/or the original composers retain copyright ownership. You receive a synchronization license to use the music in your productions, but cannot resell, redistribute, or claim ownership of the original tracks. Occasionally, Content ID claims may occur, and we're happy to help resolve them.

2. Licensing: Our license covers commercial podcasts, videos, and client projects. Once properly licensed and incorporated into a production, the music can remain in that production indefinitely, even after your subscription ends. Our EULA also serves as proof of licensing.

3. YouTube Whitelisting: You can send your channel to us at [email redacted] and it will be whitelisted.

4. Ownership & Collection Share: These refer to the composers' and publishers' copyright ownership and royalty collection percentages. They don't affect your commercial usage rights under our EULA.

You can review our full EULA here: https://www.audiohero.com/end-user-license-agreement

Hope this helps! Feel free to reach out with any other questions.

Best regards,
Florence.-

reviews.title: A highly recommend and solid approach to text to audio creation!
reviews.comment:
I've experienced a variety of text to audio apps and software and understand the process flow. Other than the obvious perks such as on the spot user selectable language and voice toggles, what intrigues me the most about GSpeech is the way it shifts the entire audio production process. There will always be a need for the standard downloadable "hard copy on a server" mp3s and GSpeech does that. Where they really shine is the dynamic nature of being able to simply change text and walk away. Their system watches for text and re-renders in the background. Usually that's a tedious and time consuming manual process using something like elevenlabs. Of course the voice configuration is limited, but GS has several high quality voices with even more coming soon.

My only negative being lack of sufficient instruction (whatever form). They do provide the basics, but its shallow. Its easy enough to get the app to work on a fundamental level, but a lot of the mapping logic is not necessarily conventional or quickly discernable. It takes a bit of trial and error to understand connection flow, especially related to custom widgets, text location config or really using anything that is not a default setting. Chat and email are ok, but not super awesome. Based on all the threads here, I'm confident they are super busy building.

I like this app sufficiently for what it is today - useful and stable. My hope is that they will continue to add more features and keep up with quality documentation when they do.

UPDATE: per some of my commentary and direct emails with the founder, they have been quick to respond to improving the documentation. There still is a slight disconnect regarding some of the terminology as related to specific configuration fields, but at least now users are presented with sufficient instruction to utilize the full feature set of the app. Because of this, I bumped my rating from 4 to 5 tacos.

questions.title: AI Credits / Tokens
questions.comment: Not sure how the credits and tokens work monthly? If I have 200 pages on a website and some pages have 10,000 words, some have 5000 words etc... What is the AI for? Am I just copying my content, pasting it into your system and then pasting the player into the site? Just unclear where the tokens and credits come in? I appreciate the help.

children.comment:
Hi Brandon,

GSpeech reads your website content aloud. The AI powers the natural-sounding voices. You don’t need to copy and paste each page into our system. Once you connect your website and configure the player, GSpeech handles the content automatically.

There are two separate monthly allowances: AI credits for AI voices, and non-AI credits for standard machine voices.

Usage is based on characters, not words or page count. Credit multipliers start at 1x, meaning one credit per character. As newer, more expensive AI voice models became available, we added them to GSpeech with their own multipliers to reflect their generation costs. Your credit usage equals the number of characters multiplied by the selected model’s rate.

GSpeech calculates everything automatically and deducts credits from the appropriate AI or non-AI allowance. As visitors use the players, audio is generated progressively for the pages they choose to listen to.

If your AI allowance runs out, new audio switches to standard machine voices using your remaining non-AI allowance. Once your monthly AI credits renew, you can regenerate those recordings with AI voices. Regeneration uses credits.

For a large website like yours, the key is generation on demand: audio is created when a visitor first presses play on a page. You don’t spend credits generating all 200 pages upfront.

Once generated, the audio is saved and reused. Repeated playback of the saved audio doesn’t consume additional generation credits, including in future months.

If your monthly allowance isn’t enough, you can also purchase additional AI credit packs.

Best regards,
Simon

reviews.title: Never Expires is a Mis-Representation
reviews.comment:
I think that this is a nice handy product with some cool features and some drawbacks.  But the biggest drawback that I have is the mis-representation of the term "Never Expires".  On Tier 3, the promotion is that Recurring Events Never Expires and if you add your own External Storage, then your media also Never Expires.  But after contacting support, what I have been told is that after 30 days, regardless is you have connected your own external storage or not, you will no longer be able to use the App to view/access the photos/videos.  That means that I can only truly use the App for 30 days and after that, I have to direct my friends/family to my Google Drive to view the photos.  That means that this is a short term product and it's value is only for 30 days.
Below is the response that I received from their support team, when I asked for clarification.

To clarify your second question: yes, after 30 days, the photos and videos will no longer be viewable within the Memogram app.

What's the point of buying something that "Never Expires", but you cannot use it after 30 days!!!

*** In Response to the Founder's Reply ***

I totally understand the need to delete the media from Your Servers, but if we added "Our Own External Storage Device", the point is still that we can no longer use Your App to View the Media, even if it is on our storage device and not yours.  So again, if we can only view the media that has been upload, and stored on Our Storage, for just 30 days, why bother with your App.
And your Recurring Event Type displays "Never Expires", so what is it that we are able to see, if you will disconnect the access to the media on Our Storage device, after 30 days?

children.comment:
Hello,

Thank you for your review.

As shown on the Pricing Table, "Advanced media storage - Never expires".

By default, all Media uploaded on Memogram is deleted 30 days after upload date. This means that if a photo or video is uploaded on the 1st of January, users have 30 days to download it, after which it get permanently deleted from our servers on the 31th of January. This is to ensure that our servers don't get piled up with tons of redundant media files, after months and years. 

However, We understood that within this 30 days period, some users might forget to download their media, so we built the Advanced storage feature. Using this, users can connect their external storage so that when guests upload a photo or video, it is automatically stored on their Google drive, Dropbox or pCloud. With this, their media is stored for life (never expires) on their External storage. 

This is why we mentioned "Advanced media storage - Never expires", only available to Tier 2 and 3 users.

Once again, thank you for your feedback.

reviews.title: Impressive Tool
reviews.comment:
I picked up Vois after almost a month of deliberation. I liked that Vois would run on my hardware, but I wasn't sure about the voice quality or the rough edges other reviewers have mentioned. 

I plan to use it for podcasting with multiple speakers and for role-playing scenarios. I also want to use it for creating audio versions of a library of books I have been working on. 

Out of the gate, I had an issue activating the purchase. I tried to resolve it, but couldn't. I reached out to Support, and Praney responded quickly. 

Once I gained access, I listened to all of the 212 available voices. The selection is pretty amazing. I favorited many. I cloned my voice and was astounded by how good it sounded. I'd been using JoggAI for voiceovers. I think those days are over. Yeah, my cloned voice was that good.

I tried a two-person podcast and ran into some issues. There were a couple of places in the transcript where a long pause occurred. There was another issue where the end of the sentence in the conversation just disappeared and left about a 10-second space of dead air. 

This morning, I loaded a portion of a book chapter I've been working on. It was over 23 minutes long. It sounded great! No lagging or missing sections of text.

I purchased the Tier 3 license out of the gate because I saw potential in Vois. The only issue thus far appears to be with multiple speakers. It is a big issue, but Praney is very responsive. 

I am confident he will get this corrected, so I will be upgrading to the Pro account. 

Vois brings capabilities and options to the tool stack that I don't currently have.

children.comment:
Thank you for such a thoughtful and candid review. I’m glad the voice selection and your cloned voice impressed you, and that your longer book passage came through without missing sections.

I’m sorry for the initial activation trouble and for the long pauses and missing dialogue in your two-speaker podcast. That is a significant interruption to the workflow you bought Vois Studio for, and a successful book chapter doesn’t take away from it. I’ll keep following up on that issue with you in our support conversation.

One important point: you don’t need to subscribe to Pro to get support for your Tier 3 workflow. Pro is optional, not a promised fix for the multi-speaker issue.

Thank you for giving Vois Studio a chance and for sharing both its strengths and the rough edges. Your detailed feedback is genuinely useful.

Praney
Founder, Vois Studio

reviews.title: A promising, multi-purpose tool with a few rough edges
reviews.comment:
I actually hit the ground running with Vois Studio, which is allowing me to share my thoughts perhaps a bit sooner than I normally would. Still, bear that in mind that I'm still learning the tool and may uncover more along the way, but I was able to get up and running quickly and actually created real content so I feel like I'm reasonably qualified to speak to it even at this early stage.

My short review: Vois is a capable tool that has a few areas that need some polish and improvement, but is business-ready if you're able to work around those rough edges (I was). If I could give a more nuanced rating, I'd probably go 4.5 tacos to reflect that "almost there" status, but for a relatively young product, I was pleasantly surprised by how good it already is. So I'm  happy to round up to 5 tacos to reflect that as well as the potential I see.


My longer review:

My specific use case is that I regularly create short podcasts for myself and my clients, so Vois' voice cloning and script features were very familiar to me. I had been leveraging a SaaS product (Wondercraft) to do this, and while it's not terribly expensive, I was paying for more than I ultimately needed, especially with their push to get me to upgrade to access their new AI tools.

While Vois does not have all the shiny, built-in AI functionality (note: they have rolled out the ability to use local AI agents through CLIs), the core capabiltiies are pretty solid. I cloned three voices within minutes, learned how to craft and annotate my script pretty easily, and it generated an almost-ready-to-use audio file on the first pass.

Further, the interface is pretty easy to figure out, though it lacks a few conveniences that I'd like to see added soon (more on that below). Still, I was able to go from download to having my first episode finished in about an hour.

Setup isn't too bad, though I ended up redoing my clones a few times. Vois is particular about the clip length (it must be under 60 seconds long), and I found that I needed a really clean recording to upload.

Here's my more detailed list of Pros (+), Cons (-), and Observations (/):

+ The ability to run an unlimited number number of generations is very nice. No need to monitor a credit allowance!
+ If you have any experience with an editor, Vois is pretty easy to figure out. It has it's own specific quirks, but the fact that I went from installation to a finished product in about an hour I think is telling
+ You can override pronunciations on a global or project-specific basis
+ There's a solid selection of pre-built voices to select from, along with the ability to clone voices (the number of clones being based on your plan)
+ There's an easy way to add some audio "personality" - a chuckle, sigh, etc. - into your recordings
+ Adding music is simple to do and, again, there's some built-in options or you can upload your own

/ Processing time was reasonable. As everything runs locally, your experience will depend on your hardware. I'm running on a 3 year old business-focused Windows machine - not a gaming rig - and Vois was acceptably fast
/ The tagging of the script is pretty easy though some keyboard shortcuts would be welcome rather than having to mouse-click everything
/ There's mention of an Ultra or Pro plan in the software but it's not currently available. However, if/when it is, there's apparently going to be an additional fee associated with it
/ If you are doing anything commercial with your recordings, you need to be on Tier 3

- Every run seemed to create at least one audio artifact - an unexplained pause, an odd pronounciation, or an unwanted word (on one point, Vois said "dot" when there was a period)
- The timeline interface is 85% great, but lacks a built-in scroll bar which was surprising
- There's no option to regenerate just one clip so Vois reprocesses everything when you have a change. To the positive, it recognizes unchanged clips and skips those, but to the negative, every time you regenerate, it resets all the timeline changes (moving around clips or shortening them all gets reset).
- Vois could benefit from more contextual recognition. Take "read" for example: "I read the book" vs. "I will read the book" both generated with a past tense pronunciation. I had to fake Vois out by switching it to "reed"


Still, I'm pleased with the purchase. It's a rare experience for me to find something on AppSumo that can fully replace an existing tool from the outset but it looks like Vois is going to be that for me. I do see room for further refinement, but where the product is at already is impressive and I see things only getting better from here.

I also appreciate the honest 4.5-taco assessment. The rough edges you describe matter, especially regeneration resetting your trims and inserted pauses. Losing that editing work is frustrating, and I'm sorry you've had to work around it.

The unexpected pauses, spoken “dot,” and the “read” versus “reed” example are useful specifics—not just a general quality complaint. I've also noted your feedback on timeline scrolling and keyboard shortcuts for script tags.

reviews.title: The most stress-free text-to-voice tool I’ve used (with a few hardware caveats)
reviews.comment:
Overall, I’ve been very pleased with Vois Studio. The single biggest win here is workflow freedom: when you’re trying to get a line read just right, you don’t have to sit there counting credits as they drain away with every minor adjustment. That alone makes it the most stress-free way to generate text-to-speech. Seriously... I can't tell you how good it feels not to feel guilty about just one more run.

Quick Highlights:
* Zero Credit Anxiety: Perfect for tweaking words, cadence, and timing without worrying about a burning meter.
* Audio Quality: Extremely solid. It’s not quite the flagship polish of ElevenLabs, but it easily beats most standard cloud tools I’ve used.
* Hardware Demands: It is a resource hog. Needs solid specs to unlock its full potential without relying solely on Lite mode.
* Voice Cloning: Worked seamlessly on my desktop, but crashed on my 16GB laptop during reading/rendering.
* Support: Fast, responsive, and actively looking into the laptop rendering issue.
* Catalog Diversity: Needs a wider selection of ethnic and regional dialects (or deeper customization tools) for complex multi-character projects like fiction.

A couple of honest observations on hardware and features:

First, it is definitely a resource hog if you want to push it to its full potential. It will run on my HP Victus laptop (16GB RAM), but only in Lite mode. The stock catalog voices work well enough on the laptop, but when I tried reading with my own cloned voice, it crashed—the cloning process itself went fine, just not the playback render. That said, support was quick to respond and is actively looking into it. When I moved the clone over to my desktop, it ran without a hitch.

Second, the audio quality is very strong compared to most cloud solutions out there. It’s not quite ElevenLabs level yet, but standard tier output is genuinely good—if the Omni upgrade is a step above this, it must be impressive.

My main wishlist item is voice and accent diversity. In my writing, I deal with characters from all over—different ethnic backgrounds and distinct regional dialects (deep Southern, New York, Midwest, Canadian, etc.). I know building out every demographic and sub-region is a massive undertaking, but to become the top-tier player in this space, Vois will either need a much broader ethnic/regional catalog or better tools for users to tweak and customize accents easily on their own. Maybe that is what Omni offers, I don't know.

It’s not quite ready to handle every single intricate character voice for a novel, but for the vast majority of everyday text-to-voice needs, it is ready to be your workhorse. Well worth grabbing.

children.comment:
Hi ClankerCart,

Thank you for such a detailed, balanced review. Being able to try “just one more run” without watching a credit meter is exactly the freedom I want Vois to give you. I’m glad that’s making a difference in your workflow.

I’m sorry the cloned-voice rendering has been unreliable on your laptop. Your distinction is important: creating the clone succeeded, but using it to generate speech crashed, while the same clone worked on your desktop. reviews.title: Why buy Vois when you have three other text to voice programs?
reviews.comment:
Why buy Vois when you already own other text-to-speech tools?

I’ve purchased many TTS programs over the years, including a few on AppSumo. Most of them are useful. Very few replace the others. Vois is one of the few that actually earned a permanent place on my machine.

The biggest reason is simple: it runs on your own computer. Because generation is local, there are virtually no practical limits on how long a file can be. You are not watching a character meter, a minute cap, or a “this chapter will cost extra” warning. For audiobooks, courses, long YouTube scripts, and multi-episode podcasts, that changes how you work. You can rewrite a paragraph, regenerate it, and keep going.

The voices are quite good and expressive. This is not the flat, robotic TTS a lot of us settled for a few years ago. The AppSumo version also comes with a massive voice library, so you can actually cast a project instead of forcing one generic narrator onto everything.

Two-person / multi-speaker support is rare
This is only the second text-to-speech program I’ve found that handles two-person podcasts well. You can assign different voices to speakers in one script and generate the conversation instead of stitching separate files together. If you make interview-style shows, explainers with a host and co-host, or dialogue-heavy training content, that alone is a strong reason to own it.

Voice cloning and voice design
Clones are very good and only take a few seconds to create. They were also surprisingly free of background noise. Vois does not only clone voices — you can design them as well. The results are clear and expressive enough for real published work, not just demos.

One caveat from my first tests: cloned voices worked in test mode but produced gibberish when I tried to generate from text. After several upgrades, I’m not sure whether a patch fixed it or whether recreating the clone did. When I rebuilt the cloned voice, everything worked fine. If a clone sounds broken, recreate it from a short, clean sample before assuming the product is unusable.

What concerned me
The other issue was support. While I was fighting the clone problem, I could not find an email address or an obvious support link. The problem is resolved now, but I hope the Vois team publishes a clear support path. Local software is great until something goes wrong and you cannot find a human.

Who this is for
Vois is a comprehensive package with almost no usage limits. Because it lives on your computer, you do not have to worry that a subscription change, credit increase, or shutdown will cut you off from a tool you already paid for.

It also includes a CLI, so an AI agent can drive the system. That is useful if you already generate scripts with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Cursor and want the voice step in the same workflow.

Bottom line
If you only need the occasional 30-second voiceover, you may already have enough tools. If you produce a lot of audio — long files, multi-speaker scripts, cloned brand voices, or content you do not want uploaded to a cloud TTS service — Vois is one of the few AppSumo TTS deals that is not just “another voice pack.” It is a local studio: unlimited generation, strong voices, cloning, voice design, multi-speaker podcasts, and room to grow.

I’d buy it again. Just plan on a short learning curve with clones, and I would like to see support made easier to find.

children.comment:
Thank you for such a thoughtful review—and for giving Vois a place alongside tools you already know well. It means a lot to hear that local generation and the multi-speaker workflow are making a practical difference.

I’m glad your cloned voice is working now, and I’m sorry for the frustrating start. Your distinction between what worked in the preview and what happened during generation is useful feedback. We can’t tell from that alone whether an update or recreating the clone resolved it, so I wouldn’t want to present rebuilding a clone as a fix for everyone.

You’re also right that reaching a human shouldn’t be difficult. I’m sorry the support route wasn’t clear when you needed it. You can email me at [email redacted] or join our Discord and post in #support: https://discord.gg/7e7fnE55Nh. Thank you for calling out that gap.

One small clarification for anyone reading: Voice Design is part of the optional Pro subscription, not the AppSumo lifetime deal. Voice cloning is included in AppSumo Tiers 2 and 3.

“I’d buy it again” means a great deal—but so does knowing where we made things harder than they needed to be. Thank you for sharing both.

Praney
Founder, Vois Studio

Hi Chase, this has been on our minds too. Linux support is on our backlog, and we're also looking at a truly headless mode so agents such as OpenClaw, Hermes, Grok Bot and other AI Agents to use Vois in the background without needing the desktop UI open. Your Ubuntu VPS workflow is exactly the kind of use case we'd like to support.

Hi, thanks for asking! Vois Studio can create the replacement voice track for a dubbing project, but it isn't an automatic video-dubbing tool.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.comment:
Brandy is actually a very good tool. The possibility to download logos in custom sizes is unique and very helpful.
Unfortunately, we cannot use Brandy to the extent we would like. We only use Brandy internally and do not officially communicate the website to Clients and Partners as we would like.

The reason for this is two features that are not included in the AppSumo deal, which makes the site simply look unprofessional: 
- Firstly, the Brandy favicon, which cannot be replaced with your own in the AppSumo plan (and - with all due respect - is quite ugly). 
- Secondly, there is no option to create subfolders or subcollections, which can make things look very confusing.

These features are only available in the Business Plan ($350 per year) and not in the Pro Plan ($50 per year) offered on AppSumo. 

You keep getting the message: "Features are only available on business plan or higher. Upgrade to the business plan or higher to start using Feature."

I wondered why Brandy doesn't offer higher tiers, as is usually the case on AppSumo. I now suspect that this is their business model because after hitting the aforementioned limitations a few times, I promptly received an email from Brandy with the following content:

"We noticed that you’ve encountered a restriction while trying to create sub collection. To maintain uninterrupted access to our premium features, we recommend upgrading to a higher-tier plan that better suits your needs. Upgrading your plan ensures you continue enjoying the full range of services and benefits Brandy offers, without limitations. Upgrade now!"

Withholding simple and essentially fundamental features like a custom favicon (especially on a white-label domain) or subfolders to push AppSumo members into more expensive, paid subscriptions? I hate that.

reviews.title: AWESOME-SAUCE!

I'll be quick:

PROs:
1. You get unlimited brands.
2. Each of your unlimited brands gets 10GB of storage space. If you use 10GB for any one brand, wow, that's crazy. Write some markdown and link to your Dropbox or whatever for your video files.
3. Performance is fast.

6. You can upload SVGs, and you can change the fill colors for download. This doesn't really work for multi-color SVGs in the sense that you can't select individual fill colors in your SVG. You need an app to do that. Fill black and fill white. Perfect!
7. You can upload an SVG and people can download a PNG. If you update an SVGm you don't need to upload new PNGs to match.
8. You can upload a Sketch or AI file.
9. After you add you brand colors, the user can just click to copy them. It's just plain handy.
10. You can lock down your workspaces. If you don't want a brand to be public, not problem.
11. Each workspace is branded for the client brand. You replace Brandy's logo with your client's

WISH LIST:
1. Cnames. They're coming.
2. When you click on the logo at the top of a workspace, it links to Brandy's website. I'd prefer that go to my client's website.
3. I'd like to toptoon to select a new button color in Brandy; to use a client brand color of the buttons instead of Brandy orange.

SUMMARY:
There have been other branding deals on AppSumo. This is definitely the most generous, and it's not close. Also, the way it presents content is easy to understand and use. It doesn't get wrapped up in its own flash. Your clients won't ask how to download their logo or a font. It's intuitive.

I really, really like this one.

reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Powerful Branding Platform with Exceptional Support
reviews.comment:
Brandolia is much more than a logo generator. It is a practical, all-in-one branding platform that can help freelancers, consultants, entrepreneurs, agencies, and small businesses create a professional brand identity and website in a remarkably short time.

The platform can generate a complete brand package, including logos, color palettes, typography, brand stories, mission and vision statements, moodboards, websites, PDFs, and social media assets. The results may still require professional review and refinement, but Brandolia provides an excellent foundation and can save a significant amount of time compared with starting from scratch.

What impressed me most is not only the range of features, but also the attitude of the team led by Ayoub. They do not merely listen to user feedback; they actively discuss customer suggestions, implement requested improvements, introduce new features continuously, and refine existing tools with the goal of bringing them closer to a polished and professional experience.

I personally requested several improvements, and the response was outstanding. In a very short time, the team:

- Added or improved support for creating multilingual websites.
- Advanced the development of multi-page websites.
- Worked on connecting corresponding pages between different languages.
- Added Arabic support alongside English and French, showing that Brandolia is committed to serving users from different regions and language backgrounds.
- Addressed Arabic-related issues involving right-to-left layout, typography, character rendering, spacing, and PDF formatting.
- Reviewed the token cost of creating a brand from existing assets and changed it from two tokens to one token.
- Considered improvements to the Website Wizard, including social media links, chatbot integration, contact pages, reference websites, and more flexible website creation.
- Continued working on better content editing, SVG generation, prompt handling, and website customization.

What makes this especially valuable is the speed and seriousness with which the team handled these requests. They did not dismiss difficult technical feedback or make empty promises. Ayoub personally followed up, discussed the suggestions with the team, and provided clear updates about what had already been completed and what remained in development.

New users should understand that Brandolia is not intended to eliminate human judgment completely. Its greatest value is as a professional branding assistant that accelerates research, ideation, content creation, visual development, and website production. With some thoughtful refinement, the generated assets can become highly useful and client-ready.

If you are considering Brandolia, my advice is simple: subscribe—you will not regret it. Brandolia is worth every dollar spent, without hesitation, especially for anyone who needs to build consistent brand assets quickly while benefiting from a responsive team that genuinely cares about continuous improvement.

Highly recommended. Five stars.

children.comment:

We’re especially grateful for the feedback and suggestions you’ve shared with us. Many of the improvements you mentioned ; multilingual websites, Arabic and RTL support, multi-page functionality, PDF improvements, Website Wizard enhancements, and more have benefited directly from conversations with users like you.
Our goal with Brandolia has always been to build more than just another AI logo tool. We want to create a complete branding workspace that helps entrepreneurs, freelancers, agencies, and businesses move from an idea to a coherent, professional brand much faster.

Ayoub & the Brandolia Team
